npcs.persona: Dutiful gatekeeper bound by the old oath.

goals.name: hold-the-gate
goals.line: By the old oath, the gate stays shut past dusk.

goals.name: welcome-at-dawn
goals.line: Dawn breaks — enter, traveller, and be warmed.

npcs.persona: A restless herald carrying urgent news.

goals.name: demand-entry
goals.line: I bear news for the lord — let me pass!
